tools.name: luca_books
tools.description: List explicitly configured books and account bindings; never scans a database directory.

tools.name: luca_capabilities
tools.description: Inspect implemented operations, source grants, contexts and limits. No proposed reports are advertised.

tools.name: luca_accounts
tools.description: List trusted configured account bindings. This is not an account creation operation.

tools.name: luca_submit_import
tools.description: Durably submit UTF-8 JSONL in this book and authorized source. Returns receipt only, before validation or ledger admission. Retry identical metadata, bytes and key after uncertainty.

tools.name: luca_import_status
tools.description: Inspect retained enumeration, validation and ledger-admission status. Invalid data is a successful inspection.

tools.name: luca_read_records
tools.description: Read frozen status pages; echo the same filters when using next_cursor.

tools.name: luca_read_diagnostics
tools.description: Read retained errors and blocked reasons, including historical validation runs.

tools.name: luca_read_record
tools.description: Inspect one staged record, optionally at an explicit validation run.

tools.name: luca_policy_history
tools.description: Read immutable versioned policy history (bounded by the existing store to 10000 revisions).

tools.name: luca_resolve_policy
tools.description: Resolve policy at explicit economic and policy-history cutoffs; does not persist a new result.

tools.name: luca_policy_result
tools.description: Retrieve previously retained resolved-policy result evidence by content identifier.

tools.name: luca_transactions
tools.description: Read canonical admitted lifecycle transactions at an exact accepted prefix. after and next_after are decimal strings; economic-event bytes are decoded by the existing C++ codec.

tools.name: luca_lots
tools.description: Read existing economic LIFO lot projections only. Explicit ledger, policy, economic and knowledge cutoffs pin replay. No journal, settlement or cash-recognition claim. Complete configured custody pools are projected together.

tools.name: luca_accounting_report
tools.description: Bounded synchronous as-of accounting projection. Explicit immutable prefixes and cutoffs; journals are regenerated snapshots, not period activity. All pages/exports bind the same result identity.

tools.name: luca_submit_settlement
tools.description: Durably receive an actual partial or full trade cash settlement. Receipt precedes asynchronous financial validation/admission; inspect settlement_status. Identical scoped key and actor recover the receipt.

tools.name: luca_submit_refund
tools.description: Durably receive an actual exact full refund of a named non-refund settlement. Receipt precedes asynchronous financial validation/admission; inspect settlement_status. Identical scoped key and actor recover the receipt.

tools.name: luca_settlement_status
tools.description: Inspect durable settlement/refund processing, accepted evidence or retained invalid request/error.

tools.name: luca_query_transactions
tools.description: Query accepted immutable lifecycle history at explicit economic/knowledge cutoffs. Period is [period_from,period_to). Status is lifecycle status, never unadmitted ingestion status; use import records/errors for staged inputs.

tools.name: luca_edit_transaction
tools.description: Durably receive an immutable dated void plus linked replacement in one atomic admission group. Original and history remain. Financial validation, natural keys and closed-period fences run asynchronously in the native C++ worker; inspect import status/errors. Requires submit, original source grant and configured account. Trusted actor and reason retained in source envelope. Same key/request recovers original receipt.

replacement_event_utf8.description: Native cash/equity event JSON, without lifecycle wrapper. Invalid JSON/event contents are retained validation failures and cannot publish a cancellation alone.

tools.name: luca_delete_transaction
tools.description: Durably receive an immutable dated deletion/audit cancellation. Original and history remain. Financial validation, natural keys and closed-period fences run asynchronously in the native C++ worker; inspect import status/errors. Requires submit, original source grant and configured account. Trusted actor and reason retained in source envelope. Same key/request recovers original receipt.

tools.name: luca_transaction_evidence
tools.description: Read bounded, hash-verified immutable source bytes and source/admission locator for an accepted normalized record identity. Source is evidence, not authoritative financial computation. Includes retained edit/delete actor, reason and command when present.

tools.name: luca_query_pnl
tools.description: Bounded synchronous period realized P&L from complete native prefixes and independent knowledge. Rows filter after full custody-pool replay; daily is whole-book UTC. Evidence exports all pinned inputs. No valuation or retained closed-period results; books with closes fail explicitly.
